articles.summary:

articles.title: Hackers Exploit ChatGPT and Claude Website Typos to Deliver Malware and Hijack Browsers
articles.summary:
Oleg Zaytsev traced 186 lookalike domains across 27 AI brands, including Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Perplexity, Midjourney, ElevenLabs and Cursor. He named the delivery pattern TypoPrompting. Ordinary typing errors led visitors to ClickFix lures, browser-hijacking malware and search-hijacking extensions. articles.title: Hackers Hijack Microsoft SQL Servers Using T-SQL Commands to Install Gh0st RAT and Crypto Miners
articles.summary:

articles.title: Chinese-Speaking Hackers Weaponize Cairn AI Framework to Breach Semiconductor and Defense Organizations
articles.summary:

articles.title: Researchers Discover 6 Zero-Day Vulnerabilities in Danfoss Refrigeration Controllers Allowing Remote Root Access
articles.summary:

He found them in under an hour of manual firmware review. All firmware versions up to and including 5.3.2 are affected. articles.title: 11 Vulnerability Scanners: The 2026 Buyer’s Verdict Guide
articles.summary:
